name: phone69_460h_mel_layer5_layer8
detector: cosine_diff local peaks and valleys, no additional smoothing
deployment: commit/push local, server fetch + fast-forward pull, then launch tracked script
software_tests: local only; no GPU memory probe on training server

limitations: Triple-stage uses a fixed 11050 budget for all epochs; double-stage changed from 6500 to 11050 after epoch 16, including a non-exact mid-epoch bridge.
Accuracy and runtime advantages are hypotheses until local evaluation after training.
